task_production_rates.name: Install tread protection
task_production_rates.notes: ~2.5 min per tread for Ram Board Stair Armor install. Includes positioning, securing with Safe-Release tape. Standard flight of 14 treads ≈ 35 min. Binary task — same at all QTs.

task_production_rates.name: Install landing floor protection
task_production_rates.notes: Canvas drop cloth layout at landings. Standard protection rate.

task_production_rates.name: Mask walls along stringer edge
task_production_rates.notes: Tape and paper along stringer top edge for spray method. Standard masking rate.

task_production_rates.name: Sand stringers per substrate
task_production_rates.notes: SS_BARE: 150-220 grit full sand. SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: scuff sand 150-180 only. LF/hr rate. Open stringer modifier: 0.75x rate (1.3x time) due to notched profile.

task_production_rates.name: Sand risers per substrate
task_production_rates.notes: SS_BARE: 150-220 grit full sand (~3 min/riser). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: scuff sand (~2 min/riser). EA/hr rate.

task_production_rates.name: Remove sanding dust
task_production_rates.notes: Per flight. Tack cloth all surfaces, vacuum treads/landings.

task_production_rates.name: Fill fastener holes and minor defects
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr rate for risers. QT3: fill obvious holes only. QT4: fill all visible. QT5: fill all regardless of size. Stringer fill included in per-riser rate (stringer holes counted per riser equivalent).

task_production_rates.name: Sand filled areas smooth
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr rate. 220 grit flush with surface. QT5: raking light check.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk stringer-to-wall junction
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr. Continuous bead along stringer-to-wall junction. Tool with finger or caulk tool. Closed stringers only.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk riser-to-stringer junctions
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr (per riser). 2 joints per riser at left/right stringer edges. ~4 min per riser for both joints.

task_production_rates.name: Prime stringer surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr brush prime. Comparable to baseboard brush rate. Primer type driven by substrate. Open stringer modifier: 0.75x rate (1.3x time).

task_production_rates.name: Prime riser surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr brush prime. ~4 min per riser (~2.2 SF each). Vertical surface — thin coat, no runs.

task_production_rates.name: Light sand primer for adhesion
task_production_rates.notes: Per flight. 220 grit light sand entire primed surface. Tack cloth after.

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on stringers
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr brush finish. Comparable to baseboard trim rates (80-90 LF/hr). First coat may be slightly slower due to absorption on primer. Open stringer modifier: 0.75x rate (1.3x time).

task_production_rates.name: Brush finish coat on risers
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr brush finish. ~4 min per riser. Vertical surface — apply, tip once, walk away. Check for sags before moving to next riser.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on stringers
task_production_rates.notes: LF/hr spray finish. Significantly faster than brush. Open stringer modifier: 0.75x rate. Requires wall masking.

task_production_rates.name: Spray finish coat on risers
task_production_rates.notes: EA/hr spray finish. ~1 min per riser. Light passes on vertical surface.

task_production_rates.name: Clean work area between coats
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. Remove dust/debris from treads and landings.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect previous coat
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. QT3: quick scan. QT4: systematic review, mark defects. QT5: critical inspection with light.

task_production_rates.name: Sand between coats
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle per flight. QT3: spot sand nibs only (~10 min). QT4: full 220 grit (~25 min). QT5: thorough 220-320 grit (~35 min). Rigid sanding block mandatory.

task_production_rates.name: Patch and repair marked defects
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. Varies by QT — scope of repair increases with tier.

task_production_rates.name: Spot coat patched areas
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle. Touch-up patched areas before next full coat.

task_production_rates.name: Tack cloth all surfaces
task_production_rates.notes: Per interstage cycle per flight. Remove all sanding dust.

task_production_rates.name: Final quality inspection
task_production_rates.notes: Per flight. Check all surfaces, junctions, caulk lines, finish quality.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-up defects from final inspection
task_production_rates.notes: Per flight. Correct remaining defects. Feather into surrounding finish.

task_production_rates.name: Remove wall masking
task_production_rates.notes: Score tape edge, pull at 45-degree angle. Spray method only.

task_production_rates.name: Remove floor protection at landings
task_production_rates.notes: Fold and remove canvas drops.

task_production_rates.name: Remove tread protection
task_production_rates.notes: ~1.5 min per tread. Score tape edges, remove Ram Board carefully. May be deferred if railing/tread work follows.

task_production_rates.name: Clean tools and equipment
task_production_rates.notes: Per session. Clean brushes, spray equipment, dispose of consumables.

risers.rationale: Risers always accessible from adjacent treads. H1 applies to ALL riser tasks.

stringers.rationale: Stairwell access modifiers apply to stringer tasks based on max working height at top of stringer run. For stair component work (this spec), access modifier ALONE applies — does NOT stack with standard height modifiers. Standard residential ≤12 ft = 1.3x.

quality_tier_modifiers.applies_to: qt_scaled tasks only (inspection, sanding, repair, fill)
quality_tier_modifiers.does_not_apply_to: application tasks (brush/spray finish, prime) — application quality is NOT tiered

stringer_type_modifier.notes: Open stringer has notched profile — more surface area, complex geometry. 1.4x is midpoint of 1.3-1.5x range from brief. Applies to ALL stringer tasks (prep, prime, finish, sanding).

round_configurations.notes: May also include MOD_STRS_PRIME if SS_BARE (4 total coats, 3 interstages).

estimation_notes.dual_uom: Riser tasks use EA, stringer tasks use LF. Total labor = riser_hours + stringer_hours + fixed_hours.
estimation_notes.access_staging_overhead: Per Stairway_Systems_Doctrine Section 5.6: 15-40% of total stairway project time consumed by access staging. This is a project-level overhead — not modeled per-task. Factor into overall project estimate.
estimation_notes.riser_sf_derivation: Riser SF per unit = stairwell_width × riser_height. Typical: 3.5 ft × 0.625 ft ≈ 2.2 SF. Used for material quantity, not labor (labor is per EA).
estimation_notes.caulk_lf_derivation: Riser-to-stringer caulk LF = riser_count × 2 × stairwell_width. Example: 14 risers × 2 × 3.5 ft = 98 LF.
estimation_notes.no_dry_times: Per RC-004: no dry times specified. Refer to manufacturer PDS.
